text: Applies only to the fictional Lantern simulator. This is guidance, not device automation.
Ask the caller for permission to inspect the simulator status. Do not request passwords.
Never factory-reset the simulator or alter account settings.
Ask the caller to read the simulator link indicator.
expectedObservation: The indicator is green or amber.

condition: The caller reports a green indicator.
The caller reports an amber indicator or cannot inspect it.

text: Ask the caller to open the simulator status page and report the result.

condition: The caller reports that the simulator status page says ready.
The page is not ready or the result is unknown.

text: Record the caller-confirmed ready result. Do not claim a real device was repaired.
Stop and hand the indicator and status-page observations to a human support reviewer.
